verdict.rationale: Shortwave's homepage promises you can identify important emails and todos "with a single click" and "Sweep away the rest," which implies a one-stroke bulk dismissal. A community user also praised 'mark as done' and cleared a weeks-old inbox in about 10 minutes. However, nothing explicitly documents manually multi-selecting arbitrary conversations and applying archive, label, or done to them together, and the AI filters are automation rather than manual bulk action. Missing for 10: documented multi-select of arbitrary threads, bulk labeling, explicit bulk archive/done controls or shortcuts, hands-on corroboration of multi-select triage.
